description.value:
Transcendent · Not a Law, Not a Mass — A Direction · Unknowable, Not Merely Unknown

Where the Halving is provable math and the Singularity a real astronomical category just out of reach, the Outside is neither — no equation, no gravity well, nothing to plot a course toward. What channelers describe isn't a place or a thing but a direction, past even the border the Reckoner's own Outside pillar of Faith names. No two accounts of channeling it ever agree — on geometry, on how much time passed, on basic facts — and that persistent disagreement is the closest thing anyone has to evidence it's real. Its counterpart teaching order, the Unlettered, pass it down by voice only; every attempt to write it down has produced pages later readers can't agree on, word for word.

pov.text: The other three are at least in the same argument — a mass, a math, a withdrawal, all things a rival could in principle contest. There is no confirmed account of it noticing the other three exist, or that a rivalry is even the right shape of question to ask about it. The Unlettered take that as the whole point: whatever it is, it never agreed to sit at the table the others are fighting over.
